title: Ember and Wade, fire and water.
lines: The water people are blue and smooth.
The earth people have flowers and trees on their bodies.
The air people are little clouds that float.
And the fire people are little flames that burn.
Fire and water are never friends.
A fire girl lives in a little shop.
Her mum and dad own the shop.
Ember wants to take over the shop one day.
When she's angry, her flames turn purple and something explodes.
One day a pipe bursts in the cellar.
And with the water comes a water boy.
He has to report that the pipe is broken.
Then the shop will have to close!
When he finds something beautiful, he cries.
When he finds something sad, he cries too.
Together they find out where the water is coming from.
There's a hole in a big wall.
Wade takes Ember to a place where a flower grows that only blooms in fire.
Ember shows Wade how she blows glass.
There's a little bit of steam.
A wave of water floods through the city.
Ember is stuck in a room that's filling with water.
She tells Wade everything she loves about him.
And Wade, who always cries, hears her.
He cries so much that his little drops come back.
Ember tells her dad honestly what she really wants.
She wants to blow glass and make art.
They can be friends after all.
As long as they really look at each other.
